body:
Not a blocker but I think this can be simplified to
```suggestion
    match context.get_env("PYENV_VERSION") {                                                                                
        Some(version) => Some(version),                                                                                     
        _ => Some(                                                                                                          
            context                                                                                                         
                .exec_cmd("pyenv", &["version-name"])?                                                                      
                .stdout                                                                                                     
                .trim()                                                                                                     
                .to_string(),                                                                                                                                                                                     
        ),                                                                                                                  
    }
```
